messages:
rachel_ops: Heads-up — customer reported that a `process_refund` request ended up invoking `create_credit_note` instead. Customer got a 200 and 'ok' but balance didn't change. Can repro locally.
ben_engineer: ugh. any request body / sample? sounds like a tool-selection mismatch in the router heuristics.
maria_support: pasted sanctioned request below (they redacted user ids):
```
POST /v1/call_tool
{
  "tool": "process_refund",
  "args": {
    "amount": "50.00",
    "currency": "USD",
    "reason": "duplicate_charge",
    "invoice_id": "inv_123"
  },
  "metadata": {"customer_tier": "pro"}
}
```
ben_engineer: aha — amount is a string here. Our `process_refund` schema expects `amount` numeric (int cents) while `create_credit_note` accepts string amounts. Router fallthrough matched the tool with the most permissive schema.
rachel_ops: repro steps I used: hit API with the JSON above -> tool call shows `selected_tool: create_credit_note` in the call logs and telemetry. pasted log snippet:
```
[2026-02-15T14:12:02Z] request_id=req-AZ12 router: candidate_scores={process_refund: 0.61, create_credit_note: 0.64}
[2026-02-15T14:12:02Z] router: selected=create_credit_note reason=best_score schema_match=false
[2026-02-15T14:12:02Z] router: fallback_reason=permissive_schema_priority
```
kevin_oncall: does this trigger any user-facing error? customer saw 200 but wrong outcome, so silent regression.
maria_support: yes customer reported funds not refunded, ticket escalated (severity P2). They included a quick curl — shell shows amount as quoted string because their client sends formatted currency.
ben_engineer: probable fixes:
- tighten router scoring to penalize schema type mismatches more heavily
- add a schema-strict validation step before selection (reject or coerce types)
- add tooling to prefer exact-name matches if `tool` arg present
rachel_ops: can we do a quick mitigation before a full change? maybe prefer exact tool name match when field `tool` is explicitly set by caller.
ben_engineer: implementable as a small router patch: if payload.tool present and exists in registry, bump its score +0.2 and require schema coercion only after selection. I'll put up a small PR.
kevin_oncall: add a telemetry flag so we can find other customers sending string amounts.
ben_engineer: adding a log hook to emit `schema_type_mismatch=true` for inspect. also will add blacklist rule to avoid selecting tools whose required arg types don't match without explicit coercion.
rachel_ops: customer needs a workaround now — can we suggest they send `amount` as integer cents, or set `tool_hint: "process_refund"` in metadata which we can honor immediately? which option is safer for them?
maria_support: I'll reply with two steps: 1) quick fix: include `metadata.tool_hint=process_refund` 2) long term: send integer cents. they'll try the hint and report back.
deploybot: deploy queued: router/heuristic-bump patch (#4327) to staging at 2026-02-15T17:00Z
ben_engineer: note: staging will run regression on 1200 recorded tool calls with synthetic string amounts.
kevin_oncall: after staging, please monitor `selected_tool != requested_tool` spike and the new `schema_type_mismatch` metric. I'll set an alert for >5/min.
rachel_ops: thanks all. maria — lmk when customer confirms workaround so we can close the P2. keeping thread open for deploy + monitor results.
maria_support: will update in ticket once customer tests. :thumbsup:
